acceptance_basis: W01.4: tiny/page/501-member/error/restart/recovery workloads nominated with entries, observation families, seed rules, and non-goals BEFORE any Rust comparison is viewed; complements (never duplicates) shared C05.1 work-decisions observations.
head: 2071631 (main tip at authoring; tree carries one uncommitted W01.1 drift supplement to contracts/callers.json)
ratification: workload SHAPES are frozen here; numeric budgets live in budgets.json (unratified placeholders + ratification rule); W07.2 runner executes these shapes with identical payloads/evidence/RNG across ts/prepared-ts/wasm
relation_to_c05_1: shared/workloads.json work-decisions (11 obs: backoff nominal/exhausted + sample counts, classify matrix, every scope/slot) covers leaf decision spot-checks; the wt-* shapes below cover ordered batches, scale boundaries, error precedence, and restart/recovery flows; no observation is defined in both places
seed_rules: all fixture inputs are fixed literals; stub-random sequences selected by --seed (default 1); no Date.now/Math.random/clock reads inside workloads; every observed call executes exactly once per run (C05.1 no-shadow-run rule)

workloads.observations: single-row decisions: one dispatch attempt per refusal in documented order (incl. D3c unavailable after refused-state, before guard) + one claim; backoff nominal/exhausted + exact sample counts (0 when exhausted/invalid, 1 when eligible); classify matrix incl. unclassified
workloads.purpose: minimal decision parity: each refusal/outcome legible in isolation

workloads.observations: bounded 50-row ordered batch: input z,a evidence access with sorted a,z output; duplicate claims last-wins; uncertain-only evidence calls; first exception stops later evidence; JS-order sorted output lists
workloads.purpose: ordered-batch mechanics: dedup, ordering, stop-on-error, stable evidence

non_goals: no byte proof (see W07.1 persisted corpus)
workloads.observations: 501-member freeze + chunked enumeration: admit/phantom/gap classification at the boundary; finishEnumeration only when cursor stale with nothing to admit and no gaps; honest cursors (no truncation/starvation); chunked re-drive resumes exactly
workloads.purpose: scale-boundary behavior at the 501-member freeze limit

entries: packages/work-kernel linkage decisions (W02.4/W04.3 target); current-TS oracle: packages/state/src/ports/transact.ts assertions + storage revision/version checks
workloads.observations: combined failures in fixed combos: malformed linkage + stale version; valid linkage + stale versions + cyclic clone-only state data; valid current versions + cyclic data; guard-false row-only insert; updates-only pass; forged terminal child/checkpoint; join->revision/version->serialization error precedence with zero writes
workloads.purpose: error precedence and zero-write discipline under combined faults

non_goals: no live-miniflare proof here (see W06.3 durable pilot)
no invented completion for held/awaiting states (forbidden)
workloads.observations: recovery scan plan + resume with evidence-change-between-plan-and-act; stale-claim release; restart from persisted rows with exhaustion anchors; held/awaiting progress observed without completion; mid-claim crash leaves exactly-once claim unit re-driven, never double-claimed
workloads.purpose: recovery/resume planning and restart re-drive without manufacturing completion

entries: packages/cloudflare/src/runtime/invoke.ts: F7 claim/record + child-unit commit (read-only reference until W06.2)
packages/state/src/fanout/outcome.ts: child terminal outcome + checkpoint staging
non_goals: not a CPU microbenchmark (wall-time durable run, separate from C05 local CPU harness)
workloads.observations: complete durable turn shape: cohort trigger/source+intent freeze; pending child claim; terminal replay/running hold/stale refusal; guard + authority; record transient + terminal outcomes; checkpoint staging with domain/history/replay/outbox/schedule effects; stale-claim release/recovery; wall-time distributions incl. cold/warm
workloads.purpose: complete-flow measurement shape for W06/W07: conversion + host demand + wall durable time together
